svg.text: ESP32 DevKit (30 pins) · MPU-6050 · OLED 0.96" · pot · LDR · buzzer · 3 buttons — all at 3.3 V · firmware: esp32-escape-game-dabou
• USB powers the ESP32; its 3V3 / GND feed the left rails, bridged to the right rails (top + bottom).
• I²C bus: SCL = row 7, SDA = row 10, carried across the channel; OLED + MPU-6050 share it.
• Buttons straddle the channel: GPIO on rows 11 / 14 / 17, GND on rows 13 / 16 / 19 (INPUT_PULLUP).
• Photoresistor divider: 3V3 → LDR → node row 26 (GPIO35) → 10K → GND.
